title: [4.8] TextEdit/CodeEdit: stale first_visible_line when the vertical scroll value is clamped - blank area below the text
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.8.dev4 and later (4.8.dev6 confirmed by measurement, 4.8.dev4 by source inspection) Not reproducible in: 4.8.dev3 and 4.7.2-stable. The triggering change is PR #122149 (commit ebe0fec, merged 2026-08-11T16:49Z), so it landed between the 4.8.dev3 build (51105ccbe, released 2026-08-07) and the 4.8.dev4 build (b56a91878, released 2026-08-26). Verified at source level: scene/gui/text_edit.h at 51105ccbe does not contain the `_selection_mode_update()` declaration that #122149 added, while master does. ### System information macOS 27 - Godot v4.8 dev6 - Forward+ - M3Max ### Issue description I have a plugin I developed myself called [Godot AI Chat](https://github.com/snougo/Godot-AI-Chat). It has a feature for loading conversation history. After loading a past conversation, the content of code blocks shows extra blank lines, as shown in the image; after scrolling with the mouse wheel, the extra blank lines resolve themselves. According to the LLM's analysis, this was introduced by the [PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122149) in 4.8 dev4. To confirm whether the LLM's analysis was accurate, I downloaded 4.8 dev3 and 4.8 dev4 and separately tested loading history in the plugin, and found that the issue was indeed introduced in 4.8 dev4. ### Steps to reproduce 1. open Issue Report project in Godot 4.8 dev4+ 2. open mrp.tscn and run 3. you will see the test output 4. enable Godot AI Chat plugin 5. Move your mouse into the plugin's chat message box (the chat message area in the plugin's UI), and you will see the plugin automatically load the most recent conversation from the history. Then move your mouse to the scrollbar for the chat messages and scroll up to view the code blocks in the chat messages — you should be able to see code block content with extra blank lines. 6. When you see code block content with extra blank lines, move your mouse over the code block and scroll the wheel — you will see the issue resolve itself. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) here is MRP project [issue-report.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32344578/issue-report.zip)
